name: Brudenell River Provincial Park

fees.note: $38 a night for an unserviced site; two-way (electric and water) $45; three-way (full hookups) $50, the same every night. Plus 15% HST, and a $6 + HST reservation fee per booking. Seniors 60+ and disabled persons get 10% off. PEI Provincial Parks' 2026 rate table, which applies to every provincial campground, and the park's sites on its booking site, read 2026-10-12.
